researchSynthesis: The tool favored high contrast, bold asymmetry, responsive checks, visible focus, and reduced-motion support. Its community pattern, blue/orange palette, Righteous/Poppins pairing, marquee, parallax, and aggressive press effects were rejected as category-misaligned or inconsistent with the approved Forge directions. The contracts below synthesize the useful accessibility and hierarchy guidance rather than copying the output.

styles: Authority: precise black-and-forged-gold system with technical annotation, disciplined grids, and restrained documentary movement imagery.
Editorial: warm paper and charcoal-blue field-guide system with blueprint rules, margin notes, and explanatory pacing.
Bold: human-led black, warm gold, bone, and restrained rust system with oversized statements and decisive documentary crops.
typography: Authority: narrow, engineered display face paired with a highly legible grotesk; labels may use compact uppercase sparingly.
Editorial: literary serif headlines paired with a compact sans-serif for navigation, captions, and annotations.
Bold: oversized condensed display typography paired with a sturdy neutral sans-serif; preserve comfortable body measure and line height.
Use local or efficiently loaded fonts, resilient fallbacks, and no typography that delays readable content.
colorDirections: Authority: deep black, warm forged gold, restrained silver, and off-white; verify body and control contrast independently of metallic texture.
Editorial: warm paper, charcoal-blue ink, muted brass, and pale blueprint lines; keep annotation text above AA contrast.
Bold: warm gold, black, bone, and restrained rust; large color fields create energy without neon or black-and-red gym-brand mimicry.
interactionPatterns: Use native links only for implemented Home and Forge Approach routes; planned routes are non-link text with accessible disabled semantics.
Render Book an Evaluation as a disabled control labeled Online scheduling coming soon until an EMR URL exists.
Provide visible keyboard focus, 44px practical touch targets, current-page state, semantic landmarks, and direct reading order.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion and keep content visible without animation; use short restrained transitions rather than parallax, marquees, or bounce.
Compose deliberately for 375px, 768px, 1024px, and 1440px widths and prevent persistent mobile UI from covering content.
antiPatterns: Interchangeable black-and-red gym branding, generic athlete montages, or modality catalogs.
Community counts, review walls, outcome statistics, patient imagery, readiness tests, or technology claims unsupported by Forge evidence.
Repeated active booking CTAs, fake href values, dead planned-page links, or forms before scheduling and contact destinations are supplied.
Aggressive marquee, parallax, overshoot, haptic assumptions, auto-animation, decorative gauges, and motion-dependent comprehension.
One universal configurable layout that makes the authority, editorial, and bold directions differ only by color.
stackGuidance: Use Astro static/server-rendered routes and normal navigation for the eventual nine-route production architecture.
The demo implements only Home and Forge Approach per concept plus a selector; no client-side SPA or speculative integration is needed.
Prefer semantic HTML and CSS for layout, state, and motion; add JavaScript only for behavior that cannot be expressed natively.
sourceCaveats: UI UX Pro Max is advisory design input, not evidence about Forge or its market.
The approved design spec and owner-provided facts override tool recommendations.
